'''Recopi''' was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Recopi system/Legends|Recopi system]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by five [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="CCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Recopi system/Legends|Recopi system]] was designed for the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CCW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Recopi star system in grid square M-11.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &ndash; based on corresponding data for [[Recopi system/Legends|Recopia system]]</ref>
